# Build support

These MIT-licensed sources ship with this repository for contributor and CI checks.
They do not require a separate checkout. Runtime consumers do not load them.

The initial source snapshot is from the Navi Apps SDK Tooling repository at
`15509079e21506a67a2e03a9e21130aa26f98e7c`. Keep the bytes used by
native artifact receipts in sync with those receipts when changing the tools.
